# College Marketplace

> Campus peer-to-peer commerce and escrow marketplace for verified college students.

## Features
- Verified college student authentication with college email
- Realtime Live Auctions for campus move-out clearance
- Peer-to-peer Escrow protection with 6-digit OTP verification
- Meal plan and tiffin subscription services with pause support
